description: Change alerts and checks. Target price, drop alerts, check interval, or pause. Send only what changes.

alert_on_drop.description: Email when the price drops or the product is back in stock

id.description: product_id returned when the product was added

interval_minutes.description: Minutes between two checks (1440 = daily). Checks faster than daily need a plan or a credit pack: every 60 minutes with a pack or Starter, 30 with Pro, 5 with Business. Default: 1440.

paused.description: Stop checking (and charging) for now; false resumes

target_price.description: Email the owner when the price goes at or below this amount. null removes it.

name: update_product
title: Change alerts and checks
